title: Error when using Azure OpenAI model v1.0.0
body:
**Describe the bug**
Can't use the Basic Prompting (Hello, World) starter project with the Azure OpenAI model, I'm using the same settings that have worked with previous pre-release builds.
The error message I'm getting is:

Error Building Component
Error building Component Azure OpenAI: build_model not found in AzureChatOpenAIComponent

**Browser and Version**
Edge Version 126.0.2592.68 (Official build) (64-bit)

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Install v1.0.0
2. Delete OpenAI model 
3. Drag and Drop Azure OpenAI model
4. Select global variables
5. Press the play button on Azure OpenAI model

**Additional context**
Everything worked fine in 1.0.0a60, I have reinstalled a60 again to check that the variables I'm using are correct, and everything is working fine.
Unable to test in v1.0.3 as nothing seems to be working with this build for me, I have clean installed 1.0.3

linked_prs.title: fix: azure openai model component: resource not found
linked_prs.body:
Fixes #2333

model name is not needed, users just need to refer to the deployment on azure.

ai_judgment.response: Yes. This is an agent issue as it involves an error related to the integration and usage of the Azure OpenAI model, which is an LLM provider. The problem appears to be tied to LLM provider compatibility or configuration, aligning with the "Incompatibility with LLM providers" category.
